citations.assessment: The fuller entry explicitly discusses the aleph and heh forms. Pesachim uses Rabbah for its named speaker. The print and the received spelling both have to remain visible.
The Abba entry expressly carries this name and explains its use. The Bavli seafaring account uses Abba and bar bar Hana together in the address to the storyteller.

holds.reason: Preserve the narrator’s two-person distinction and further uncertainties as he gives them. The directly compared forms do not establish the editorial identification by themselves.
